purpose: Isolate whether the newer XPU-kernel wheel improves output-qualified Qwen3.8-27B official-FP8 TP2 c64 throughput while the promoted vLLM source, model, server profile, requests, and collective policy remain unchanged.

protected_control.relationship: immutable promoted comparison; R23 cannot replace it without a separately preregistered two-fresh-server confirmation and complete c1-c64 ladder

unchanged: promoted vLLM ac7509e2 source and active site-package
official model bytes and direct-I/O manifest
TP2 server and PIECEWISE capture-1 profile
frozen request suite, oracle, harness, and output qualifier
isolation_boundary.r17_distinction: R17 combined this kernel with a later zero-overlay vLLM source and measured 736.090698 tok/s. R23 removes that vLLM confounder.

measurement.excluded_warmup: one identical c64 group after server health and before measurement
measurement.required_activation_gate: both ranks log direct P2P activation and the official block-scaled FP8 kernel selection
measurement.required_output_gate: 64 complete 128-token responses, zero cached prompt tokens, complete raw token IDs, and no cross-base frozen-oracle collision
measurement.required_cleanup: container removed, no non-wrapper model process, and benchmark port closed

decision.promising_definition: at least 5% above the protected 774.394144 c64 median with every activation, output, and cleanup gate passed
decision.if_promising: preregister a wholly fresh two-server confirmation and recover the complete c1-c64 ladder before changing a package or public result
decision.if_below_promising: preserve as a negative or neutral diagnostic; do not promote or alter the protected result
